items.t: TEVA Gets FDA Nod for Weltruza as Once-Monthly LAI in Schizophrenia
items.d: Teva wins FDA approval for Weltruza, the first once-monthly subcutaneous olanzapine injection for adults with schizophrenia, with a U.S. launch expected soon.
